newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 10 isssues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 10 isssues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp. said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 10 issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Nora Springs Community School District, Iowa, $1.2 million general obligation school bonds.
--Dover Township, N.J., $4.86 million general improvement bonds.
--Alden CSD, N.Y., $7.710 million school district GOs.
--Westhill CSD, N.Y., $3.15 million school district GOs.
--Springettbury Township, Pa., $9.08 million GOs, alternate bidding.
--Virginia Housing Development, Va., $50 million mortgage (tax) bonds.
--Virginia Public School, Va., $92.150 million school financing bonds.
